Shared frame sources/tests are actively conflicted and were kept read-only. Invalid sign inputs are rejected before output mutation. Updated stale focused callers to carry SIID and canonical LENGTH. The isolated C interop consumer drives all 8 canonical signed vectors from link_frame.json and link_frame_signed_modes.json, independently generated signatures, all four address modes, selector compatibility, max payloads, tampering of every authenticated field, legacy/reordered/MIC-included transcript rejection, malformed SIID, S/SI mismatch, encryption, reserved selectors, address mismatch, length mismatch, SIZE_MAX overflow, and atomic signature output. Unsigned canonical modes remain covered by the frame corpus. Existing QEMU RX tests prove authentication before payload publication and replay commit boundaries.
